action.new_text:
# Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    
    # Validate each input matrix
    for mat, name in [
        (logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
        (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
        (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call'),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if mat.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    normalized_weights = raw_weights if weight_sum == 0 else raw_weights / weight_sum
    
    # Compute weighted future-token losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    
    # Use stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep_mask.astype(bool), margin.astype(np.float64)
